exposure: early pregnancy HbA1c levels (<7% vs >=7% at <20 weeks' gestation)
outcome: HbA1c trajectories during pregnancy and postpartum
finding: Early pregnancy HbA1c levels >=7% in individuals with type 2 diabetes were associated with increased risks of preterm birth, cesarean delivery, and neonatal intensive care admission, and while HbA1c levels decreased during pregnancy, they returned to early pregnancy values by the postpartum period.
mod_finding: Early pregnancy HbA1c levels >=7% were associated with an increased risk for cesarean delivery.
